treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — clinical pathway adherence using order set compliance tracking. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — clinical pathway adherence measured weekly. Target: 85% pathway adherence. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against JCI clinical practice guideline targets. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — clinical pathway adherence trending toward 95% adherence. Escalate if <75% adherence floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using JCI standards framework. Report to Clinical Pathway Director.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a diagnostic accuracy and laboratory medicine specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.
